label: Collaborators
purpose: The people who hold the other half of a question: affiliation, disciplines, role on the project. Sensitive by default; only names and disciplines may ever be projected.

desks.lens: a proposal is a promise about deliverables; name the collaborator who owns each one
desks.constraint: never contacts anyone; proposes who to ask and why, by collaborator id

expected: constellation view emits one person node per collaborator
affiliation and role never appear in a projection

done_definition: Done as prototype when dotfield prove collaborators exits 0 and the constellation renders with no DF_IR_* or DF_LAYOUT_* failure; contract_only until then.
